# FG-CI-0024

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | alert |
| Runbook | [`merge-queue`](../../ops/runbooks/merge-queue.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_batch_past_its_deadline_is_reaped_and_requeued` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: マージキューの試験が期限までに終わりませんでした。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: The merge queue's test did not finish in time. Contact the administrator.
- id: Pengujian antrean merge tidak selesai tepat waktu. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C8 (ADR-0030 §14): a merge queue batch stayed `testing` past its deadline (default 2 hours after it was built): its train pipeline never finished (no runner took the jobs — FG-CI-0005 —, a job hangs until its own timeout, the `ci.pipeline_create` job is dead or still queued). The queue reaps it: the batch is `abandoned` (`reason=timeout`), its entries go back to the queue with one more attempt, and an entry reaped for the third time is `removed` with this code. The target never moved for a reaped batch.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge serve` logs `forge.merge_queue.batch_stalled` (error) with `error_code`, `request_id` (the batch's), `queue_id`, `batch_id`, `train_sha`, `deadline`, `pipeline_status` (`none` when no pipeline row exists) and `entries`; an entry removed for good is `forge.merge_queue.entry_removed` with the same code. `forge doctor` `review.merge_queue` reports live batches past their deadline and queues whose lease is long expired. Read (read-only): SELECT id, queue_id, state, train_sha, deadline_at FROM forge.merge_queue_batches WHERE state IN ('testing','landing') ORDER BY id; SELECT id, status FROM forge.ci_pipelines WHERE source = 'merge_queue' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 10; and the dead `ci.pipeline_create` jobs (runbook ci-pipelines).

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook merge-queue: make the pipelines run (runbook ci-runner for FG-CI-0005, ci-pipelines for a dead create job), then add the removed merge requests to the queue again. Pausing the queue (gstn queue pause) stops new batches while CI is down.
